duplicate_check: Bounded retune of cand_0021 from eight effective chunks to four, as predeclared before closing the family.
hypothesis: Four local heaps retain enough top-k parallelism while avoiding cand_0021's merge and weak-threshold overhead.

verifier.evidence: Part 1 CPU doubled, total Day 8 CPU rose about 50%, and matched wall medians did not improve.
limitations: Wall timing remained loaded; the CPU regression and lack of wall signal are sufficient to close this family.

learning: Per-chunk top-k heaps are the wrong primitive at both tested chunk counts; reopen only with a shared strong threshold or a different exact selection route.
